description: Use this when a shopper is about to buy something an AI suggested, or asks if a price or stock claim is right. Pass the product page `url` and the `claim`. Returns what the shop shows now, whether it matches, and a signed, dated receipt. Second Look by GAIP. Free, no account, no affiliate links; inputs must be public and non-personal.

claim.description: What the shopper was told, in plain words, e.g. "89 GBP, in stock, size M". Only the price, stock and variant are kept; the rest is discarded.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones (needed to see or remove your watches later).

url.description: Public https link to the product page on the shop's own site.

verbose.description: Optional: true returns the full result with every underlying field. Default: a short answer.

name: second_look_check
title: Second Look: check before you buy
